caption: The video captures a curvy, hurricane-shaped transparent glass centered against a pure black background, filled near the rim with a clear, effervescent liquid. A single red strawberry with a green calyx is submerged in the lower-middle of the glass, wrapped in a dense cluster of tiny bubbles. Throughout the clip the strawberry drifts slowly upward through the liquid column while its calyx turns from pointing up toward the upper-left. Bubbles continuously form, detach, and rise around the fruit and through the upper liquid, keeping the frothy coating and the streaks of gas in constant motion. In the opening moments a few bright droplets fall vertically outside the glass on the left, then vanish. The thin foamy meniscus at the surface shifts shape as the effervescence continues.
